bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$root"
rollback=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-applicant-48134d4
newtag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:applicant-live-48134d4
oldid=$(docker image inspect "$rollback" --format '{{.Id}}')
newid=$(docker image inspect "$newtag" --format '{{.Id}}')
live=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')
test "$live" = "$oldid" || exit 71
test "$oldid" != "$newid" || exit 72
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Status}}')" = running || exit 73
docker tag "$newtag" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 echo RECREATE_FAILED
 docker tag "$rollback" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p deploy -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
 exit 61
fi
sleep 10
status=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Status}}')
img=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')
restarts=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.RestartCount}}')
if test "$img" = "$newid"; then echo IMAGE_IS_NEW=YES; else echo IMAGE_IS_NEW=NO; fi
echo STATUS="$status" RESTARTS="$restarts"
if docker logs --since 180s deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY'; then ready=YES; else ready=NO; fi
echo READY="$ready"
if test "$status" != running || test "$restarts" != 0 || test "$img" != "$newid" || test "$ready" != YES; then
 echo DEPLOY_NOT_READY_ROLLING_BACK
 docker tag "$rollback" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p deploy -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
 sleep 3
 after=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')
 test "$after" = "$oldid" || exit 63
 echo OLD_IMAGE_RESTORED
 exit 62
fi
echo APPLICANT_DM_RUNTIME_DEPLOY_PASS
